name: lpqi_orm
label: LPQI: NOT + TNG + GTC + WHT + INT (ORM, La Palma)
sources: NOT technical details page (not.iac.es), GPS position 28 45 26.2 N, 17 53 06.3 W, 2382 m

Caporali & Barbieri, 'The astronomic and geodetic coordinates of the Telescopio Nazionale Galileo, Canary Island': WGS84 geodetic 28 45 14.4 N, 342 06 39.4 E (GPS, 1996-11-22, planimetric uncertainty ~5 m); the astronomic coordinates (28 45 28.3, 342 06 22.1) are the local-vertical values and are NOT used

gtc.iac.es: 'Latitude: 28 45 24 N, Longitude: 17 53 31 W, elevation about 2300 m'; altitude 2267 m from Wikipedia. NOTE: GTC FITS headers (LATITUDE +28:45:43.2, LONGITUD +17:52:39.5, HEIGHT 2348) carry the INT's position to within 6 m, not the GTC's, and were not used
ING whtcoord.html: 28 45 38.3 N, 17 52 53.9 W, 2332 m (ground floor, not the axis intersection), GPS 1993 (1994 ING Observers' Guide 1.2)
ING intcoord.html: 28 45 43.4 N, 17 52 39.5 W, 2336 m (ground floor)
notes: ENU relative to the NOT from the surveyed / published dome coordinates: NOT GPS, TNG geodetic survey (~5 m), WHT and INT ING GPS pages, GTC web page (arc-second). Pairwise 409 m (TNG-GTC) to 1518 m (GTC-INT, the project's '1.5 km'); NOT-TNG 532 m against the published 550 m.
up_m from the quoted altitudes (ground floor for WHT / INT, dome for the others): indicative only.
The five-telescope network is the planned extension of the Pathfinder; every station carries the Pathfinder's published detector here.
assumptions: stations (GTC position at arc-second precision; up_m)
